title: The influence of a dicationic surfactant on the aggregation process of the IVAGVN peptide derived from the human cystatin C sequence (56–61)
content:

Julia Ludwiczak, Emilia Iłowska, Michalina Wilkowska, Aneta Szymańska, Marek Kempka, Maria Dobies, Kosma Szutkowski, Maciej Kozak
Research of the effect of the dicationic gemini surfactant (3,3′-[1,8-(2,7-dioxahexane)]bis(1-dodecylimidazolium) dichloride (C6IMIC12) on the fibrillation process of the IVAGVN peptide using microscopic, spectroscopic and molecular docking techniques.
